observations.observation: vega virtual-device start prints 'Deadline reached but virtual device unresponsive' yet exits 0; callers must check virtual-device status, not the exit code.
A start killed without virtual-device stop leaves 'A snapshot operation for <build> is pending' and every later boot exits immediately; no CLI reset/repair command exists (only start/status/stop).

Each wrapper call is a fresh bwrap (--die-with-parent, per-run /tmp, 300s wall limit): a VVD started in one call is dead in the next, so start/install/launch/input/capture/stop must be one invocation (vvd-run3.sh).
